en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an industrial mining complex with tall brick chimneys, power‑house style buildings and surrounding yards in a hilly landscape. The caption under the image reads "Pécs bányatelep Schroll akna". The reverse side has Hungarian printed text "Levelező-lap", a red 10 fillér Magyar Kir. Posta stamp, handwritten message and address, and a printed publisher line at the bottom.
